<thought>To design a concise 2‑step synthesis, I will disconnect the target molecule at the sulfonamide N–S bond and at the amide C–N bond. This gives three commercially available precursors: (1) p‑toluidine, (2) 4‑aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride, and (3) trans‑cinnamoyl chloride. Step 1: acylate 4‑aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride with trans‑cinnamoyl chloride to afford 4‑(cinnamoylamido)benzenesulfonyl chloride. Step 2: react this sulfonyl chloride with p‑toluidine to form the final sulfonamide. Both transformations are standard (acid‑chloride amidation and sulfonyl‑chloride sulfonamide formation) and have corresponding retrosynthetic templates in the database. I will retrieve suitable template IDs for each step and then construct the required JSON route.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccc(NC(=O)C=CC)cc1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["amine", "acid chloride"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
